desc: 靠墙一体书桌带背架抽屉与同色高书柜，小户型书房学习位
leaf: 实木书桌书架一体学习桌（靠墙带背架抽屉书桌 + 同色高书柜组合）
name: 小户型实木书桌书柜一体款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒交代书桌加背架与同色高书柜的靠墙一体定位，用真实书房角和椅子尺度让人代入自己家。
shots.textZone: upper-left block: Latin kicker line, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」, one pill 「{callout_1}」, two circled thin-line icons labelled 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 干净孤立的书桌剪影用于搜索位与平台主图位，去场景只留造型与抽屉背架结构。
shots.textZone: one small rounded pill chip 「{callout_1}」 low-left on the oatmeal field, never across the product

shots.intent: 俯拍小房间里书和本子摊在地板与椅面的真实凌乱，逼出靠墙一体收纳的需求。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #3E322A plus one thin leader line to one label 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 正侧机位交代桌面进深、腿部净空与靠墙贴合，用椅子和台灯锚住真实尺度。
shots.textZone: right margin: kicker 「{callout_1}」 and one label 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 正交立面加引线讲清台面、后侧背架层板与两侧抽屉的收纳机制，一图解释怎么用。
shots.textZone: right label column: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and three blocks 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 each with a thin leader line to its part

shots.intent: 低角度仰视把同色高书柜的层高节奏、门板形式与底部抽屉一次交代，撑起整组收纳量。
shots.textZone: left band: four numbered circles with short labels 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_4}」 and one headline 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 掠射微距把小圆拉手、抽屉缝隙、封边与腿榫交接做实，用可见做工替代资质话术。
shots.textZone: one label 「{callout_1}」 with a thin 1px leader line to the joint

shots.intent: 正俯视摊开抽屉与背架的实际分区与可放物，用可核验的收纳实拍降低决策风险。
shots.textZone: right column: four numbered circles with short labels 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_4}」 and one headline 「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 同光同框对比桌与柜分开各占一块地与靠墙连成一条工作台面，让人自己看出占地差。
shots.textZone: two small corner labels 「{callout_1}」 on the left panel and 「{callout_2}」 on the right panel, one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in the centre seam band

shots.intent: 把可选门板形式与台面规格压成四张同角度卡，让买家一步完成选型不犹豫。
shots.textZone: one thin-line circled icon plus one pill label per card 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」, one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 across the top band

shots.intent: 傍晚台灯下的书房角配一张信息干净的规格卡收口全页，给一条明确的行动指令。
shots.textZone: upper right: a thin 1px rounded spec card #FBF8F2 with four rows whose values are placeholders 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」, closing headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one rounded action chip 「{callout_5}」

style.backgroundSystem: a real study wall corner reused across every frame: warm white matte plaster #FBF8F2 with a painted white skirting, pale wood floor #E0CFAE under a low-pile grey-cream wool rug #CFC9BF; infographic screens switch to one flat oatmeal card field #EDE4D7 with thin 1px rounded frames; one clean text zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: warm-minimal solid-timber study furniture ecommerce, airy daylight interior rather than moody studio
style.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms seated inside 1px outlined circles, single uniform stroke weight, #3E322A strokes on the light fields and #EDE4D7 strokes on dark fields, simple geometric desk/shelf/drawer marks, maximum four per screen, no filled 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: soft wrapped daylight from camera right at 5000K with a low left bounce fill, gentle grounded shadow under every leg, plus one raking grazing pass that reads shelf edges and timber grain; never flat shadowless studio, never a single hard long cast shadow, all shadow tips agreeing with the declared right-side source

style.presentationRules: identical desk proportion, drawer count, back shelf band height, leg profile, bookcase tier rhythm and door fronts in every frame; verticals corrected and straight; real chair or table lamp used as scale anchor so furniture size reads true; product stands on the rug or floor with a believable contact shadow, never floating; the 3/4 hero angle reused on scene screens so the set reads as one room
style.surfaceSystem: supplied finish rendered exactly as sent: solid-timber faces with visible open grain and fine saw marks, crisp square-tapered legs, small turned knob pulls, honest shelf edges caught by raking light, glazed or open door fronts kept as supplied; matte, no gloss repaint, no plastic sheen
style.typography: one rounded humanist sans family throughout, with a small uppercase letter-spaced Latin kicker line above each headline; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」, headline 26-36pt, subtitle 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt, total copy budget under 50 characters per screen, no dense body text
